# FKN Wine — LLMs.txt

> Wine deals and honest buying guides. We check the fine print — price per bottle, commitment, cancel terms — and we don't fake reviews. Every price and term carries the date we checked it.

## Club reviews (the paperwork, not the landing page)

- [Firstleaf](https://fknwine.com/wine-clubs/firstleaf/) — $44.95 first box (6 bottles), ~$16.50 a bottle after
- [Winc](https://fknwine.com/wine-clubs/winc/) — ~$16–20 a bottle at member pricing
- [The California Wine Club](https://fknwine.com/wine-clubs/california-wine-club/) — from $49 per shipment, ~$24.50 a bottle
- [Naked Wines](https://fknwine.com/wine-clubs/naked-wines/) — $40/month into your own wine account
- [Gold Medal Wine Club](https://fknwine.com/wine-clubs/gold-medal-wine-club/) — from $49 per shipment, three tiers
- [Wine Access](https://fknwine.com/wine-clubs/wine-access/) — $150 per shipment; ~$25 (Discovery) to ~$75 (Connoisseurs) a bottle

## About

FKN Wine is an independent, reader-supported site about wine value: deals, fine print, and honest
verdicts. Content is based on verifiable information (offers, terms, published ratings); opinions
are marked as opinions. When we have not tested something ourselves, the page says so.
No fabricated reviews, no invented tastings.
Operator: Nimar Moradbakhti, Bochum, Germany · Imprint: https://fknwine.com/imprint/
